<h2>Load Trait Review Decisions</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Strictly loads a canonical trait-review decision CSV.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>load_trait_review_decisions(path_trait_review_decisions)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="path_trait_review_decisions">path_trait_review_decisions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar path to a canonical decision CSV.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A typed tibble containing the canonical decision columns.
</p>
